user: attachment style ei concept ta bujhiye bolo to, ami kokhono properly bujhini
reply:
Attachment style hocche ekta psychology concept ja bole je choto belar relationship (mainly parents er sathe) kivabe amader adult relationship e behavior shape kore. Mothamuthi charta type ache.

Secure attachment thakle manush relationship e comfortable thake, closeness ar independence er balance easily rakhte pare. Anxious attachment thakle constant reassurance lage, abandonment niye fear beshi thake. Avoidant attachment e closeness uncomfortable lage, independence ke prioritize kora hoy emotional connection er theke beshi. Ar disorganized attachment e duita mix thake - closeness chai kintu abar bhoy o lage.

Ekta jinis important bujhte hobe - eta fixed na, ekta pattern matro. Awareness thakle, ar specially safe relationship e thakle, attachment style shift korte pare time er sathe.
